phase: Air routes and aircraft types (board story E4)
fiction: The flights are fictional. Routes and liveries are invented; no airline, schedule or procedure is used.

coordinates.system: scene coordinates = local SWEREF 99 TM (EPSG:3006): (SWEREF 99 TM - origin) / (25 * 0.9996584126), origin E 569030 N 6494989; X east, Z south, Y up; 1 unit = 25 m; vertical RH2000 (vertical origin 0)
coordinates.levels: cruise and approach levels are scene Y, not height above ground
coordinates.models: aircraft models in metres in their own frame (+z forward, +y up, wheels at y = 0, +x left), placed at 1/25

sources.title: Outline of the mapped area (meta.clip of the importer output)
sources.accuracy: exact: the edge of the data the simulator has
sources.used: the limit no flight may cross

sources.title: OpenStreetMap: runways, taxiways, building footprints (ways 104336425, 104336441)
sources.accuracy: not stated; typically a few metres
sources.used: ground paths, the two points the path bends away from, the clearance check

sources.title: Which operators and types fly from Norrköping
sources.accuracy: secondary sources; no timetable taken from them
sources.used: the choice of the Boeing 737 MAX 8 (TUI fly Nordic) and the Airbus A321neo (recorded on Norrköping-Rhodes)

sources.title: Aircraft length, span and tail height
sources.accuracy: 737 MAX 8 length 39.52 m in one page and 39.12 m in another, tail height 12.30 m and 12.45 m; wheel track, wheelbase and fuselage width are remembered figures, not confirmed
sources.used: size of the drawn jets, queue spacing, wing room

types.basis: the unnamed turboprop of the earlier versions; measures of the drawn model
asked for by the user; no source read shows one at Norrköping
TUI fly Nordic's type; TUI flies charters from Norrköping

derived.deterministic: two runs gave the same SHA-256

estimates.note: Invented or estimated; none is a procedure of either airport.
estimates.speedRule: route length / cruise time of the direction, so that every flight takes the same time
estimates.typeChoice: equal chance among the four when an aircraft appears; seed from the clock per city and reset
estimates.jets: proportions of the type family (wing 36 % back, 25 degrees of sweep, engines 5.75 m out), not drawings
estimates.liveries: invented: petrol blue A320neo, brick red A321neo, mid blue 737 MAX 8; no airline shown

notData: No timetable, airline schedule, AIP procedure or traffic feed.
